text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after my first conversation with
Ikuno Dictus—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...She is running in a mock race today as
well.
With that same unwavering,
powerful stability.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"To run more than anyone else,
and to grow stronger through that experience.
...I believe that is the training regimen
that only I can undertake to achieve my
'objective.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her words and the fierce determination in
her eyes that day.
They still linger within me,
carrying a quiet warmth—

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
—If I were to describe Ikuno Dictus in a
single phrase,
it would be "exceptional stability."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one who told me this was an instructor
at Tracen Academy who oversees training for
pre-debut Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Never late,
never absent. She never misses a word,
and actively asks questions.
Her dedication to training and equipment
maintenance is unfaltering—

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
There are plenty of diligent Umamusume at
this academy. But in her case, as I mentioned,
her consistency is simply on another
level.

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
In all the time I've watched her,
she has never fallen out of form.
I haven't even sensed a hint of it.

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
To consistently maintain a fixed physical
condition no matter the circumstances...
That is undoubtedly one of her extraordinary
traits.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
—Ikuno Dictus-san has actually consulted
with me several times about self-care.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Her drive is incredible.
She pores through academic texts that even
professionals like us use,
and pays close attention to her daily diet
and sleep—

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to consciousness around
self-management,
you rarely find an Umamusume quite like
her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Just by asking around the academy,
I was able to hear endless praise regarding
Ikuno Dictus's extraordinary management
capabilities.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What could be the "objective" that she's
striving for?
As my curiosity grew day by day—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —One day, a "change" occurred.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking over the upcoming mock race schedule,
Ikuno Dictus's name was nowhere to be
found.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her name had always been listed on a mock
race somewhere,
but suddenly vanished after a certain point.
A cold chill runs down my spine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to shake the dread,
I sprint through the academy
searching for Ikuno Dictus,
desperate to prove my fears wrong—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah,
I feel like I'm finally getting there...!
Ikuno,
can we do one last tandem run together?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I spot Ikuno Dictus interacting with another
horsegirl.
After a brief exchange,
the two immediately start running.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
—Haaaaah!
...Yes, yes, yes, YES! I'm running!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes...! Excellent form...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus looks at her running partner
with quiet delight.
There are no irregularities to be seen in
her own stride...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Ikuno...!
Thanks to you,
I really think I can run in the race!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No. This is entirely the fruit of your own
hard work.
I merely offered a small amount of
assistance.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Haha,
typical Ikuno. ...I'm definitely going to
finish the next mock race!
You give it your all too, Ikuno!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes. Let us both do our best.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
If you're ever in trouble,
it's my turn to help you out!!
See you tomorrow—!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
You are the one from the other day—
...Thank you for your assistance back
then.
choice_data_list: You weren't on the roster, so I wa...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I see. Thank you for your concern.
However, rest assured. As you can see,
all parameters are normal.
choice_data_list: ...Even so, you didn't enter the race.
...Even so, you didn't enter the race.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...There was a matter that took precedence
over mock races.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...As you may have observed,
I was assisting
a classmate with her training until just a
moment ago.
choice_data_list: Yeah. You looked like you were hav...
Yeah. You looked like you were hav...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...She sustained an injury previously,
which left her unable to run for a period
of time.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
She dedicated herself to rehabilitation and
made a full physical recovery, but...
Due to the prolonged hiatus,
she fell into a state of psychological
instability—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Her body had healed,
yet she could not run to her satisfaction
and grew disheartened...
I could not simply overlook her plight.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
To relieve the tension in her mind and body
so that she could run again,
I formulated a training regimen structured
with numerous incremental steps—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I merely assisted with managing her progress
on a granular level
to ensure everything proceeded smoothly at
her own pace.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...If it appeared to you that she was enjoying
her run,
then it seems my duty has been fulfilled
successfully.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I am truly... relieved—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It is truly an admirable deed. However,
the time Ikuno Dictus
devoted to helping her friend was by no
means negligible.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
There is no issue.
The schedule adjustments accounting for
the modified itinerary have already been
completed. Furthermore—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If my actions allow her to continue running
for a longer career in the future...
That in itself is a source of joy for me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I believe that this joy will ultimately come
full circle...
and benefit my own running as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a Trainer,
that is a sentiment I can deeply empathize
with.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet at the same time,
for a student to bear such thoughts...
It is almost too selfless—
choice_data_list: ...Is there anything I can do to h...
...Is there anything I can do to h...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Before I know it,
the words leave my mouth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She uses her extraordinary capacity for
self-management to aid others;
she deserves to be rewarded first and foremost.
That conviction wells up within me.
choice_data_list: —I want you to be able to run for ...
—I want you to be able to run for ...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In that case...
If I may take advantage of your
generosity,
there is a small request I would like to
make—
